scope: Cross-review Root-authored TLS/config/flush/memory-DER TCP test sources only; not author-independent review of my own link.rs/quiet.rs.

checks.evidence: old new/connect/accept select ALPN1 only; new_with_link has ALPN2 only; raw connect/accept reject framed configuration and v2 factories reject raw.
TLS1.3 only, PKI client verifier/server-name verification, no resumption/0RTT; mapped leaf peer and serverpin stay private.
permit obtained before TLS; AuthenticatedStream owns it, moved intact into TrackingIo/h2 connection; LinkIo peer clone cannot extract/duplicate permit.

TLS+bounded h2 setup before Link driver spawn; no await after start returns Link, so setup timeout drops only pure network preparation. Root source tests cover authenticated preface stall cancellation and permit return.

Version dispatch parses original bytes into frozen schema1 or deny_unknown_fields schema2 DTO; no Value roundtrip loses duplicate keys; duplicate schema/role/data_link fields fail derived deserialization. Required framed_v2 policy validated via ProbePolicy.
Root ownership/parent/mode/hardlink/NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK/boundedread checks remain common to both schema paths. No new RPC override paths.

strict24B client preface and partial9B headers; only full unpadded stream1 DATA counts, zeroFIN tracked independently, only actual inner flush/shutdown ReadyOk publishes counters; failure/Drop wake waiters.
write/flush/shutdown Pending set true, any Ready resets false. Label is last observed underlying poll state, not proof of remote or device progress.
3 new TCP/memory-DER mTLS tests use actual socket tuples and PKI/permit/flush/credit/cancellation; do not claim trusted-file loading, helper or USB evidence.
